notes.title: Huge update for Zombie Road Rider! New maps and new zombies!
notes.notes:
Hi people!

[b]Zombie Road Rider[/b] has received a [b]huge update[/b] that was on the work for some times now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175640/Zombie_Road_Rider/

Actually, the game has received a series of updates since the last news that was posted last year ago! So what is new?

A full new environment to play! The [b]City Downtown[/b] ! Set in an environment made of skyscrapers and large roads, save the survivors who are running around and bring them to the safe house!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/95a0d1b7264481b6ac5e137bf3a7d2fe666b76aa.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/8f4e97a8c6bfae9a50ea725db8a7de4d3c9d0064.jpg[/img]

Another new environment, the [b]Industrial Town[/b]! Set in narrow streets with old industrial style buildings, largely populated with fully physics-based props, obstacles and zombies to road ride!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/98f1e6fe837711a742a3775547dfccf23bc79310.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/fee8a8ddef73791dcacdc55f7d52fc7fca266e03.jpg[/img]

[b]The Factory[/b], a modern industrial type place with barricades and zombies to destroy!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/ade6a5df7052809be50173755ebab3f195d6ac41.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/a7e51c4dc1321136d3d203c7e5a49f4ee1aa8802.jpg[/img]

Another one main new aspect of the game is that [b]+30 zombies were added [/b]to replace the old classic one, so that the game has more variety of characters!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d026c4dfa1436d565e546f9a344a423bbf313c46.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/79c36fe1d10ef8ab1a5221af2a1626267cdd9578.jpg[/img]

[b]Physics of the cars and vehicles were reworked[/b] to feel more enjoyable and powerful against the obstacles and zombies on the road. Improvements were made on the graphics and the optimisation of the game to have it run more smoothly. The menu and user interface was also reworked to be more intuitive and easier to use.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qe6t-gvPVg

The environments that were added have support for both rescue and freeride game mode!

So this pretty sum up all what you will find in this large update! I hope you will enjoy!

Best,
Devdan

notes.title: New desert environment for Zombie Road Rider
notes.notes:
A new [b]desert environment[/b] to explore has been added to the game in this update!

This new desert environment takes place in dunes through ancient buildings, road and temples.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/723f095da3584c78733bf51c905fec256586c171.jpg[/img]

It is quite as large as the forest environment and lets do a free riding with zombies, with kills counting to unlock the rest of vehicles of the game!

The desert environment is for now playable just as a free ride mode without timer, racing or survivors to rescue, but this may change later!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/c841691a9f25154af333ccbdf757b89e808a4124.jpg[/img]

The game is now consisting in terms of playable environment, of the forest with rescue mode, racing mode and free ride mode, and the desert environment as a plus !

Among this new map, more musics were added and the menu was redesigned to better showcase the new content.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/9f191945e0427b0121d4b8c79cbf2a14fcce9fd2.jpg[/img]

The amount of score to unlock the vehicles is now higher to give more life time to the game !

Fix was also done for the physics of the Lamborghini sport car which sometimes had crazed reactions when doing barrel rows.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/b3fa534c30cc6f058fe5aa86c29ddbbd6a35bbf0.jpg[/img]

Hopefully more updates and game mode will be added for the game in the future !

notes.title: MISSING EXECUTABLE ERROR (FIX)
notes.notes:
Hi, if you receive an error when trying to launch the game saying there is a missing executable, please reinstall the game.

This is due to a misconfiguration in the last update, it has been fixed now.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Zombie Road Rider out from Early Access!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/08d4ec04642d67c04dbfa18daff275fbb2079cdf.png[/img]

A new [b]update[/b] for the game which [b]redesign the gameplay[/b] and [b]adds new content[/b] is out !

The redesigning of the game consists in changes of elements of the interface and progression of the gameplay.

The HUD was lightened, menu remade, and zombies kill count to unlock vehicles lowered to have faster access to the best vehicles of the game!

Many in-games tips and on screen indications were added to help the player learning the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/35ff2d8fc805fd583af2c3f0dfb0e2c259dcd02e.jpg[/img]

[b]Difficulty was readjusted[/b] to make it harder and more challenging to complete the milestones of the game while still making it [b]easier to unlock vehicles.[/b]

Support for [b]Linux [/b]was also added so the game is now playable on Linux distributions!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/6e8504d0757ab4d3933e236b79a76b44cc35dd02.jpg[/img]

Localization was improved to have support for English, French, German, Russian, Spanish and Simplified Chinese.

As of now the game is leaving the Early Access stage ! [b]New updates [/b]will of course keep coming with the time !

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/639fe6122170dadf2876f74f728198006d87305a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New vehicles !
notes.notes:
In this update, [b]new vehicles were added to the game ! [/b]The game has now 6 vehicles to unlock and you can [b]unlock and drive these vehicles by achieving the best zombie kills[/b] when playing.

You can find above the list of vehicles which are now available with this update.

Along this update also [b]comes the support for remote play[/b] as you can now play the game on a mobile or a tablet using Steam Remote Play, and play it with the touch screen or with a gamepad !

notes.title: Leaderboards and online stats!
notes.notes:
The [b]Leaderboard[/b] was added to the game and it will now track the number of zombies kills while playing !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36051293/a20508b931de2bce27cb4672f6847eb284f1cbc1.jpg[/img]

You can see your zombies kills count and compare it with others players from the menu or from Steam here https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1175640/leaderboards/3905971/

The game scoring system was also resigned around [b]zombie kills to unlock parts of the game[/b].

Reworks were also done on the user interface to have less elements displayed on the screen and more space to focus on the actual gameplay.

Hoping the game will be more fun, you may have to replay to unlock the features with the zombies kills count instead of the classical score !

[i]Devdan[/i]

notes.title: Full controller support added !
notes.notes:
Hi,

The [b]full controller support[/b] has been added to the game ! You can now play the game with any xbox-like gamepads directly from Big Picture or on your TV screen.

There was also a rework of the menu and HUD to take the adding of controller support into account and to display the controls layout on different parts throughout the game !

[i]Devdan[/i]

notes.title: Fix for achievements
notes.notes:
Hi!

Issues with [b]achievements[/b] appeared after the launch of the game so an update has been pushed which is fixing the issues and now all achievements should unlock.

Just update the game and start a mode and when you return to the menu it should fix all previously bugged achievements that were not unlocked.

[i]Devdan[/i]
